description: This source file defines the LockSnapshot class which models an instance of a lock (monitor) held or waiting in a thread, including fields for lock type, address, package and class names, and thread ID. The class provides mechanisms for cloning, equality checking, hash code computation, and comparison based on lock address.

classes.name: LockSnapshot
classes.description: Represents an instance of a held lock (monitor object) in a thread with properties such as type, address, packageName, className, and threadId. Implements Comparable to allow sorting by address.

methods.name: LockSnapshot()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty LockSnapshot instance.

methods.name: LockSnapshot(LockSnapshot that)
methods.description: Copy constructor to create a new LockSnapshot with the same properties as the provided one.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of this LockSnapshot instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on address, considering null values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the address field.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this LockSnapshot with another based on the address string.
